coaching.headline: Fifteen minutes of losing every fight, then the 3-0 at their Fangtooth at 19.7 flipped it — the team won the late brawls and closed through Fangtooth and Genesis Core at 31.
coaching.team: Four of five lanes read unfavored and the first quarter played like it: 0-4 at 6.3, 2-4 at 8.6 and 0-3 at 15.2, every one taken while the winning offlane stayed home. The turn was structural, not lucky — from 19.7 the team fought together, took the 24.5 fight 5-3 with all ten players present, and the 4-0 at 29.7 cashed straight into Fangtooth and Genesis Core at 31. Narbash's 42,177 healing underwrote those long brawls; this comp wanted extended fights and finally started taking them.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 3-0 at their Fangtooth at 19.7 ended the losing stretch, and the 4-0 at 29.7 converted into the 31-minute Fangtooth and Genesis Core that ended the game.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 won the only favored lane wire to wire on Sevarog — 3/3/5 with 48105 mitigated. The macro note repeats three times though: at 6.3, 8.6 and 15.2 he was alive and ahead while the team lost 0-4, 2-4 and 0-3; a won offlane is a rotation license, and this game stayed close because it went unused.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Legion lived the whole arc — dead to Sparrow four times before minute 12 in a lane read 'theirs all game', then the late-game answer: kills on Sparrow at 19.9, 27, 29.8 and 33.5, including the two-man 4-0 at 29.7 with Feng Mao. Surviving to the Deathstalker and Perforator spikes at 25 and 31 is what flipped the matchup.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs lost the early jungle to Khaimera as read — down at 6.4 and 9 — then quietly won the long game: 7/5/3, 16933 objective damage, 6 wards, and the 29.7 fight where he and Legion went 4-0 against four. Feng Mao's execute wants those grouped late fights, not the early 2v2 trades.

lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 261 healing a minute, more than 98% of Renna mid players this patch.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Renna touched shortened Abyssal Rift, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 52.5s late); fight right after Abyssal Rift is spent.
Abyssal Rift at rank 3: 95s base, about 52.5s by the end (45% shorter) from 81 ability haste: Entropy 15, Magnify 15, Megacosm 10, Epoch 8, Lotus 33.
16 takedowns (6 kills, 10 assists) fed: Lotus (Eternal).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Renna dealt 35,738 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +365 magical power from items.
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Dreambinder (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 30% for 1s. Reduced to 20% for DoT Abilities.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Prima Donna (Eternal minor): Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.
Sustain: 8% omnivamp; Orb Of Enlightenment: On Ability Cast: Restore 3% Missing Health over 5s.; 8,861 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1125 health; took 40,401 damage, mitigated 26,250, died 3 times.

(game text: Upon using Soulfire, gain a 40 (+35%) Shield for 2s.) (changes Soulfire, 2.8s cooldown with their haste) Field: 52.9% in 10551 games, 78% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.6%.

Loadout Eternal Lotus: Every couple of minutes and every takedown, a random small stat bonus. Generic scaling with nothing special for her kit. (game text: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.) [33 random bonuses this game (every 2 min plus 16 takedowns), 1 in 4 each: about +8.3% damage, about +33 ability haste, about +6.2% move speed, about +10.3% max health (expected)] Field: 56.1% in 1217 games, 9% of picks, above the hero-role's 52.6%.

Loadout minor Early Bloom: An extra level when you reach level 12. Gets your next ability ranks sooner; otherwise generic. (game text: Gain an additional Level upon reaching Level 12.) Field: 52.8% in 445 games, 37% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.6%.

Loadout minor Prima Donna: You deal 10% more damage to heroes but take 6% more. A glass cannon pick for a Renna who stays back. (game text: Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.) Field: 56.7% in 201 games, 17% of picks, above the hero-role's 52.6%.

Loadout crest Epoch: Enter stasis for 2.5s, unable to act. Use it to dodge burst after Abyssal Rift teleports you into danger. (game text: Stasis Device:  Enter Stasis for 2.5s.) Field: 52.9% in 8440 games, 62% of picks, level the hero-role's 52.6%.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 5 effects on one trigger: Orb Of Enlightenment, Magnify, Megacosm, Lotus, Netherward. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Entropy, Megacosm, Dreambinder. Renna has 4 damaging abilities (Stupor hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 81 ability haste brought them back 45% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Early Bloom + Prima Donna) sits on the same trigger as the items (kept alive in fights), so every extra second in a fight made them harder to kill.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Renna killed built magical armor (Adele, Dekker). Anti-heal on Dekker, Adele, Sparrow. We killed Renna 3 times.
Copy it? Lotus (Early Bloom + Prima Donna): 55.1% in 107 Renna midlane games, above the hero's 52.6%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
